name: Dollhouse Productions
source:
Unbeknownst to you, there is a man stalking you while you're out on a "date". 

After one blissful night, Viper can't seem to forget you. And he's determined to make sure you don't forget him. 

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你不知道的是，当你出去“约会”时，有一个男人在跟踪你。

经过一个幸福的夜晚后，Viper似乎无法忘记你。他决心确保你不会忘记他。

[来自Itch.io]
